title: Fourteen Winters and One Short Lead
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：dog　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 dog 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1947 my grandfather ① kept a dog that no neighbour in the lane would have walked, and he said the keeping was the whole of the winter. The ② dog, meaning the animal and not the fellow, ran fourteen winters and stayed unnamed in the book; a dog, he said, is the only thing in a lane that is judged by how long it is left unled.

Every ③ dog in that lane had the same short lead at the door of it, and the ④ dog at the end, meaning the one they kept for the sheep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A dog, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to walk; my grandfather said the walking is the part that fills fourteen winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the dog was the whole of the story, meaning the fellow and not the animal. The ⑥ dog, meaning the fellow and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody laughs at and nobody pities; dog, he said, is either something you keep or the only word that means both an animal and a fellow. He said the fellow is the part they remember.

By 1956 the ⑦ dog had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short lead. The ⑧ dog of the whole thing, my grandfather wrote in January, was one lane and fourteen winters of walking; dog, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to walk. She said the walking was never mentioned.

The ⑨ dog I remember is the one at the end, which died in 1968 and is still described as the quietest in the lane. A ⑩ dog, my grandmother said in 1970, is the only one who improves by being walked; every dog, she said, is a fellow that has agreed to look like an animal. She said the fellow was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 狗（指巷子里养的那一只）
B. n. 狗（指那只动物本身，与那个家伙相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep a dog 养一只狗
D. n. 狗（指留给羊群用的那一只）
E. n. 狗；犬（抽象总称，指一条巷子的养犬之事）
F. n. 狗（指登记簿上写到、被列名的那一只）
G. n. 家伙；伙计（指故事里被人取笑的那个人）
H. n. 家伙（抽象总称，指人人取笑却无人怜悯的那个）

items.q: kept a dog that no neighbour in the lane would have walked

answers.why: keep a dog 意为“养一只狗”，1947 年祖父养了一只巷子里没有一位邻居肯去遛的狗。
dog 意为“狗”，指那只动物本身而不是那个家伙，它活了十四个冬天而在簿子上没有名字。
dog 意为“狗”，指那条巷子里每一只狗，每一只门口都挂着同一条短绳。
dog 意为“狗”，指留给羊群用的那一只，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
dog 意为“家伙、伙计”，指故事里被人取笑的那个人，叔叔说这个家伙就是那个故事的全部。
dog 意为“家伙”，指人人取笑却无人怜悯的那个而不是那只动物，是故事里人人都取笑、却无人怜悯的东西。
dog 意为“狗”，指登记簿上写到、被列名的那一只，到 1956 年这只狗成了登记簿里的一行。
dog 意为“狗、犬”，祖父一月写道，整件事的养犬之事是一条巷子和十四个冬天的遛狗。
dog 意为“狗”，我记得的是末尾那一只，1968 年死去，至今仍被说成巷子里最安静的一只。
dog 为抽象总称，祖母 1970 年说，一只狗是唯一会因为被好好遛而变得更好的生灵。
